title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.1.0
description:
• 🔄 Smart Registration Submit Retry: Automatically retries form submission up to 3 times without reloading on 'an error'.
• 🔁 OTP Resend Retry & Config: Customizable OTP SMS resend count (1-5x) with 3-attempt retry on OTP page errors.
• 📋 Exact Sheet Error Labels: Outputs strictly 'an error' for registration page errors and 'otp page an error' for OTP errors.
• 🗑️ Master Reset All Button: Clears all input numbers, queue, history records, and counters in 1 click.
• ⚙️ Settings Tabs Redesign: Two dedicated tabs for 'ID Creating Settings' and 'Software Settings'.
